messages:
emma: FYI Solstice is seeing recurring 429s from their dedicated pool during morning ramp (06:00-07:00 UTC). Autoscaler attempted scale but capacity never arrived. cc @liam @sofia

liam: Looking. Can you paste the auth error header and their pool id?

emma: Pool: dedicated-solstice-eu-1
Request example:
```
POST /v1/generate
x-sol-token: <redacted>
status: 429
retry-after: 2
body: {"error":"rate_limited","code":"CAPACITY_EXCEEDED"}
```
Observed 429 spike 06:02 -> 06:11 UTC, QPS peeked ~420. Their committed throughput = 250 qps.

sofia: They upgraded to a larger slab last month but their warmup cron was left OFF. Billing shows burst credits available but unused.

liam: Autoscaler logs show failed scale-up due to "auth: insufficient quota" when talking to cloud provider at 06:03. Snippet below.

liam: ```
[06:03:02] autoscaler: scale_request -> 4->6
[06:03:03] cloud-api: quota-check failed: quota_exceeded (project/solstice)
[06:03:04] autoscaler: abort scale - cloud quota failure
[06:03:05] runtime: host pool saturated, enqueueing requests
```

matt: If cloud quota was the blocker, fallback routing should've kicked in to hosted models to avoid 429s. Why didn't routing fire?

liam: Routing had a legacy tenant tag that marked this pool as "no-fallback". That prevented the policy from routing to a compatible hosted variant. Investigating why tag was present.

emma: Customer reports client-side retries amplified the surge — they use retry=3 with 500ms backoff. That made queueing worse.

sofia: Immediate mitigations proposed:
- increase client backoff (suggest 10s jittered)
- temporary manual reserve to 500 qps while we fix infra
- enable their warmup and run gradual ramp
- patch routing to allow fallback

liam: Agreed. Action items and owners:
- matt: request cloud quota bump (raised ticket 06:40 UTC)
- liam: patch routing tag and deploy (in progress)
- emma: enable warmup script for Solstice + run staged ramp (starting 07:10 UTC)
- sofia: notify customer, coordinate payment/commit if needed

emma: Warmup run we executed:
```
for qps in 50 100 200 300; do run-for 5m --qps $qps; sleep 2m; done
```
Early results: latency p95 improved ~2.3x, tail latency down, 429s dropped to zero after routing fix + warmup.

sofia: Customer confirms traffic is healthy now. For postmortem and right-sizing recommendations:
- why autoscaler didn't surface cloud quota sooner (alerting gap)
- why tenant had no-fallback tag (config drift)
- recommendation: baseline commit = 350 qps, peak buffer = 600 qps, target utilization <= 65%

liam: I'll open infra ticket with full logs, cloud request IDs, and remediation steps. Will link to the runbook for "quota-failure" ops. Tagging followups: #runbook, #billing-review.

matt: Note: billing shows burst credits were available but warmup disabled, so credits sat unused. Need doc/update to surface warmup + credits to customers during slab upgrades.

deploy-bot: deployment liam/route-fix v1.2.8 succeeded @ 07:05:12 UTC :rocket:

emma: Closing this thread. I'll draft the postmortem and move to docs/pm-237-solstice-dedicated-rightsize.md
